page.overview:
Who is Isebaille Tobanyi?

Faile mentions Jestian Redhill, Isebaille Tobanyi and Mashera Donavelle as examples of Aes Sedai who would do anything the White Tower told them to do. It is said that Isebaille delivered the throne of Arad Doman and brothers that she loved to their enemies upon command from the White Tower.
